name: query_user_info
description: 查询企业平台用户基本信息、账户状态、所属部门和创建时间
sql_template: SELECT id, username, email, department, status, created_at FROM users WHERE id = :user_id OR username = :username LIMIT 1

name: query_service_metrics
description: 查询微服务或模块的实时运行指标（QPS、错误率、平均延迟与健康状态）
sql_template: SELECT service_name, qps, error_rate, latency_ms, status, updated_at FROM service_metrics WHERE service_name = :service_name ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

parameters.name: service_name
parameters.description: 微服务或系统模块名称（如 auth-service, order-api）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 返回记录数量，默认 5 条

name: query_active_alerts
description: 查询平台当前未解决的告警与故障通知
sql_template: SELECT alert_id, service_name, severity, summary, created_at FROM system_alerts WHERE status = 'firing' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 最大告警返回条数，默认 10 条
